description: Get the live status of one of the verified phone's rides by its booking code. Requires session_token from verify_code. If the ride has a linked flight number, the response also reports whether a flight-delay-triggered reschedule has happened (Quo watches linked flights and proactively shifts the pickup time when one runs late), the returned `when` already reflects any such reschedule, no separate lookup needed.

code.description: Booking confirmation code, from reserve_ride/reserve_and_pay's response or list_my_rides

name: get_ride_status
title: Get ride status
